title: France: packaging EPR registration
summary: A producer placing packaged household goods on the French market must hold a unique identifier and contribute to an approved eco-organisme.

sources.title: Code de l'environnement — Art. L541-10-1 (Légifrance)
sources.note: Direct fetch of legifrance.gouv.fr was blocked by its bot-check page; text below is quoted verbatim from Légifrance's own page via search, not from memory, but could not be re-fetched to double check today — re-verify with a browser before relying on this for the live catalog. FINDING: this requirement's original single citation, Art. L541-10, is the *general* extended-producer-responsibility principle that applies to all REP categories, not packaging specifically. The article that actually brings household packaging under REP is L541-10-1. SIGNED OFF 2026-09-20 (Tabeen Raoof) on this basis; the manual browser re-check of the Légifrance text is still outstanding and should happen before this is relied on for a customer-facing verdict.
